title: Comprehensive Plan - Future Land Use
description:
The 'Future Land Use' map layer included in the 'Lenexa Comprehensive Plan', adopted July 2024.

'Future Land Use' is a key component of the Comprehensive Plan as it identifies where various uses are compatible and desirable in Lenexa, will guide development in the community for the next 20 years, and is a key legal factor in reviewing rezoning requests and other types of development requests
snippet: The 'Future Land Use' designation included in the 'Lenexa Comprehensive Plan', adopted July 2024.

title: City Annexations (1967-Present)
